title: The Signature Benchmark Database — Signature ID Encode/Decode Round-Trip
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Benchmark: Signature ID Encode/Decode Round-Trip. Target: JAH deterministic ID coding (JAH-<CODE>-NNNNNN) Metric: IDs encoded+decoded per second; round-trip exactness Methodology: Signature-original benchmark. Encode 50000 numeric ordinals to JAH-BM-000001 form and decode back; assert every decode returns the original ordinal. Scoring: Higher IDs/sec is better. Pass: all 50000 round-trips exact. How to run: save the record program as bench.js and run: node bench.js. The program executes the benchmark, checks its own assertions, and prints a RESULT line with the measured values. How to read results: records_per_sec (or the per-benchmark unit) is the measured throughput on the build machine; assertions listed under recorded_results all passed. Beginner exercise: run the program twice and compare the measured timings — correctness assertions must pass both times while timings vary slightly. Advanced pattern: use this benchmark as a regression gate — re-run after any change to the measured operation and compare against the recorded results.

RESULT {"ids":50000,"total_ms":20.64,"ids_per_sec":2422800}
